verdict.rationale: Extend exposes a broad programmatic surface. Every processing endpoint (extract, classify, split, parse, edit) is available via API in sync and async modes. Processors can be saved and referenced by ID, evaluation-set runs and workflow versioning are documented, webhooks can be configured by API as well as in the dashboard, and deletion APIs cover every resource. Official SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server are also documented. However, the evidence never states UI/API parity, and several UI-centric features (Studio iteration, Composer & Review Agent, human review routing, workflow authoring) are not shown to be fully API-accessible. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity guarantee, documented API coverage for Studio/Composer/review and workflow building, and independent hands-on confirmation.
